change_history.description: Initial comprehensive analysis of all repository issues

bugs.title: Python generator - defects in the runtime functions
bugs.description: Six critical defects in Python runtime functions including frame support issues, comparison logic flaws, and operator failures

bugs.title: Unknown MetaAndTemplateFields in Golang
bugs.description: Generated Golang code references MetaAndTemplateFields type that is never generated, causing compilation failures
technical_details: Missing struct definition in org_isda_cdm_metafields package
Should contain: Id, Key, Reference, Scheme, GlobalKey, ExternalKey fields
Code generation gap between references and type definitions

bugs.title: Python generator does not implement all Rosetta expressions
bugs.description: Generator crashed when encountering unsupported expressions like 'extract' or 'distinct' in conditions
bugs.resolution: Implemented RosettaExpressionSwitch class to ensure comprehensive expression support

bugs.title: Python generator does not handle the path operator correctly
bugs.description: Path operator handling issues in Python code generation

bugs.title: Incompatible Types error thrown converting List of String(Enum Value) to List of FieldWithMetaString
bugs.description: Type conversion error when generating Java code for fields with metadata annotations
technical_details: Error: java.util.List<java.lang.String> cannot be converted to java.util.List<com.rosetta.model.metafields.FieldWithMetaString>
Triggered by [metadata scheme] annotation on string fields
Related to CDM PR#2997 changes in metadata handling

questions.title: Simplify the testing and release process

Must enable CDM generation in test configuration
Tedious manual revert process before PR submission

data_quality.title: Generated JSON schema is incorrect
data_quality.description: JSON schema generator fails to include 'value' child element for meta reference fields
technical_details: Missing 'value' child under meta reference fields
Prevents proper reconstruction of objects from JSON
Specific issue with [meta reference] annotations in Rosetta files

data_quality.title: JSON schema generator does not generate the correct structure
data_quality.description: Schema generator fails to properly represent nested object properties
technical_details: Correctly references parent types via $ref but doesn't expose nested properties
Issue with property flattening when classes extend base types
Prevents complete validation of object hierarchy

key_insights.insight: While the project supports multiple target languages (Python, Java, Golang, C#, Scala, DAML, TypeScript, JSON Schema), several generators have incomplete implementations. Python generator has been the focus of recent development efforts (Phase 2 completion in June 2024), but still lacks full Rune function support and some operators.
key_insights.impact: Users face runtime failures and compilation errors when using certain language features or DSL constructs

key_insights.theme: Type System and Metadata Handling Complexity
key_insights.insight: Proper handling of metadata annotations, meta references, and type conversions is a recurring challenge across multiple generators. The interaction between Rosetta's type system and target language type systems creates impedance mismatches.
key_insights.impact: Type conversion errors, missing type definitions, and incorrect schema generation affect code quality and usability

key_insights.insight: The development workflow for contributing to code generators is complex and error-prone, requiring manual configuration management and lacking automation. Setup documentation is incomplete, creating barriers to entry for new contributors.
key_insights.impact: Slows down development velocity, increases risk of configuration errors, and limits community contributions

key_insights.insight: Multiple code generators lack proper namespace disambiguation when types share identical names across different namespaces. This is a fundamental architectural issue affecting C#, Scala, and DAML generators.
key_insights.impact: Prevents code generation for valid Rosetta models with certain naming patterns

key_insights.insight: The Python generator has historically had incomplete coverage of Rosetta DSL expressions and operators, though Phase 2 addressed many gaps. Remaining issues include ->> (deep path) and default operators.
key_insights.impact: Limits the expressiveness of models that can be successfully generated to Python

key_insights.insight: JSON schema generation has structural issues with nested properties and meta references not being properly exposed in the schema. This affects the ability to validate JSON data against the schema.
key_insights.impact: Generated JSON schemas cannot fully validate data structures, reducing their utility for API development and data validation

architectural_decisions.decision: Pydantic v2.5 Adoption for Python Generator
architectural_decisions.rationale: Modernize Python generator to use latest Pydantic version for improved performance and features
architectural_decisions.impact: Breaking change for users of Pydantic v1.x, but provides access to modern Python tooling ecosystem

architectural_decisions.rationale: Centralized expression handling to ensure comprehensive coverage and prevent future gaps
architectural_decisions.impact: More maintainable expression handling with compile-time checks for missing implementations

architectural_decisions.rationale: Support multiple target languages (Python, Java, Golang, C#, Scala, DAML, TypeScript, JSON Schema) from single Rosetta DSL
architectural_decisions.impact: Enables broad ecosystem adoption but creates maintenance challenges across generators

architectural_decisions.rationale: Use Maven for dependency management and build orchestration
architectural_decisions.impact: Standard Java tooling but creates complexity in configuration management for testing

common_patterns.observation: New target languages are added but may not initially support all Rosetta DSL features
Translation between Rosetta's type system and target language type systems creates conversion challenges
Special handling required for Rosetta annotations (meta, scheme, reference) across different target languages
Some code generation issues only manifest at runtime in generated code rather than during generation
Major improvements delivered in coordinated phases (e.g., Python Phase 2) rather than incremental updates
examples: Python Phase 2 with Pydantic v2, operators, metadata, functions

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design robust type system mappings between UML and target languages from the start, with special attention to metadata, generics, and nullable types
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Type conversion issues are a major source of code generation failures. Invest in comprehensive type mapping early.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Implement compile-time checks (like RosettaExpressionSwitch) to ensure all DSL constructs have code generation handlers
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Missing operator implementations cause runtime failures. Build safeguards to catch incomplete implementations during development.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design testing and release processes that don't require manual configuration management. Use profiles, environment variables, or automated scripts.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Complex development workflows slow velocity and introduce errors. Prioritize developer experience in tooling design.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Implement robust namespace disambiguation from day one. Handle cases where UML elements share names but exist in different packages.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Namespace collisions are a fundamental architectural issue that's hard to fix retroactively.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Create thorough setup documentation with troubleshooting guides before opening to contributors
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Incomplete documentation creates barriers to adoption and contribution. Documentation is infrastructure.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design a clear framework for how UML stereotypes and tagged values map to target language constructs
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Metadata handling is complex and affects multiple aspects of generation. Need consistent approach across languages.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Include comprehensive runtime library tests alongside generation tests. Test the generated code, not just the generator.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Many issues only manifest when generated code executes. Need both generation-time and runtime testing.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: If generating schemas (JSON, OpenAPI, etc.), ensure nested properties and complex types are fully represented
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Schema generation requires deep understanding of target language type systems and serialization semantics.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: When adding new target languages, be explicit about feature coverage gaps and provide clear roadmap for completeness
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Users expect feature parity across languages. Set clear expectations and prioritize coverage completion.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Include generation metadata (tool version, source model, timestamp) in generated code as comments or constants
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Generated code traceability helps debugging and version management. Small addition with significant value.
